title: Proposed collaboration on acid sphingomyelinase deficiency

sentences.text: Exploring a research collaboration on acid sphingomyelinase deficiency
We are writing to Niemann-Pick UK, and would also value the views of the National Niemann-Pick Disease Foundation and the International Niemann-Pick Disease Alliance.
This condition is linked to lysosomal enzyme deficiency and the resulting storage of material in lysosomes.
The International Niemann-Pick Disease Registry includes people with this condition.
A national natural history study in adults and children is not yet recruiting.
An olipudase alfa study is completed, an earlier enzyme replacement study and one transplant study were terminated, and another transplant study is active but not recruiting.
Olipudase alfa is listed as an enzyme replacement approach.
We would like to explore a jointly designed study on acid sphingomyelinase deficiency, shaped with your community from the start: [study question], [design], [sites].
Any participation would follow informed consent and ethics approval, and we would share what we learn with your community.

sections.heading: What we would ask of you

sentences.text: Would you be open to a conversation about whether this idea is useful to the families you serve?
If so, we would value your view on how your community, registry or natural history work could take part, with proper consent and ethics approval.
We are not asking for any personal information about patients or families.
Could we arrange a short call at a time that suits you, perhaps [proposed dates]?
With thanks and warm regards, [researcher name], [institution].
